modmenu.summaryTranslation.easyauthclien: Chat automation and auto-login for EasyAuth servers.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.easyauthc: Client-side companion for EasyAuth: per-server chat/command automation rules and auto-login, with optional TOTP codes.
easyauthclient.config.title: EasyAuth Client
easyauthclient.config.password.tooltip: Stored as plain text in credentials.json. Clear this field to forget the server.
easyauthclient.config.totp.tooltip: Enables automatic {otp} codes. Storing the secret here makes this computer the second factor.
easyauthclient.config.globalAutoLogin.to: Send /login automatically on servers that have the command and a saved password.
easyauthclient.config.globalAutoRegister: On servers with a /register command and no saved password, register with the default password (or a random one) and remember it.
easyauthclient.config.useSessionToken.to: "Remember me": after a successful login the server issues a one-time-rotating token, used instead of the password on the next join. EasyAuth 4.0+ servers only.
easyauthclient.config.usePasskey.tooltip: Ed25519 challenge-response login: a key pair is generated per server and the secret never leaves this computer. EasyAuth 4.0+ servers only.
easyauthclient.config.clearKeys.tooltip: Removes the stored session token and the local passkey pair for this server. The next login uses the password again.
easyauthclient.config.defaultPassword.to: Used by auto-register. Leave empty to generate a random password per server.
easyauthclient.config.loginCommand.toolt: Template for the built-in auto-login, e.g. /login {password}. Its first word is also what is looked for in the server's command tree. {otp} is appended automatically when a TOTP secret is set.
easyauthclient.config.registerCommand.to: Template for the built-in auto-register, e.g. /register {password} {password}. Its first word is also what is looked for in the server's command tree.
